data.name: Sange
data.detailed_description:
High above a dying kingdom, an immense gothic citadel hangs over a fog-choked abyss.

In Sange, you fight as a spectral warrior surrounded by hordes of cursed enemies wreathed in flame. Cross ruined halls, towering battlements, and ritual arenas while mastering fast, deliberate isometric combat where positioning, timing, and commitment determine whether you survive.

Chain melee strikes, dash through closing formations, defend against incoming attacks, and unleash powerful special, power, and ultimate abilities. Every action has its own range, timing, and cooldown. Reckless aggression will leave you exposed, but hesitation allows the horde to surround you.

Your wounds follow you from one level to the next. Health is not freely restored between battles, making every mistake matter and every healing opportunity valuable.

When the final enemy falls, the angel shrine at the heart of the arena awakens. Approach the fallen angel and choose a reward that shapes the rest of your run. Increase your movement speed, accelerate your attacks, reduce ability cooldowns, or recover precious health before entering the next level.

Survive long enough and the enemy ranks give way to powerful bosses capable of dashing across the battlefield, stunning you at close range, and unleashing deadly abilities of their own.

Sange combines responsive action combat with a severe dark-fantasy aesthetic: monumental stone architecture, distant ruined spires, cold spectral light, burning enemies, and vast structures suspended over an endless darkness.

A Note About the Game's Artwork

Sange is currently being developed by a solo developer.

Some artwork and visual assets in this early demo were created using generative AI as temporary development assets. As development progresses, these will be replaced with original, non-AI artwork and production assets for the full release.

Thank you for playing Sange at this early stage of development.

data.short_description: Sange is a fast, run-based isometric action game set in a crumbling dark-fantasy citadel. Carve through burning hordes, master a powerful arsenal of abilities, awaken fallen angels, and carry hard-won upgrades into brutal boss encounters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti, AMD Radeon R7 260X, or equivalent OpenGL 3.3-compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required. Integrated graphics are not officially supported.

content_descriptors.notes: Gameplay contains frequent fantasy violence. The player fights humanoid and supernatural creatures using melee attacks and magical abilities. Enemies are struck, defeated, and may disappear or collapse. The game does not contain sexual content, sexual violence, drug abuse, self-harm, or realistic graphic gore.
